PRE-REGISTRATION (STEP 0): Histologically confirmed muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma of the urethra, bladder, ureter or renal pelvis
Radical surgery (cystectomy with lymph node dissection or nephroureterectomy or ureterectomy) must be ≥ 3 weeks and ≤ 12 weeks
Metastatic disease defined as new or progressive lesions on cross-sectional imaging or bone scan.
Patient must have a diagnosis of high grade upper tract urothelial carcinoma
Patient must have locally advanced (unresectable and/or not amenable to curative intent therapy) or metastatic urothelial cancer
Patient must have had prior exposure to anti-PD(L)1 therapy
